messages:
rachel: Noticed recurring missing-span clusters aligning with hourly finalization around midnight UTC for the last 4 days. Opening thread to assign remediation owners and a clear timeline.

rachel: quick root-hypothesis: aggregator finalizes windows on a fixed inactivity cutoff; late-arriving spans from transient producer backpressure are getting excluded. Pattern repeats every ~24h.

aditya: do we have an example span batch id or trace?

rachel: trace batch id: tb-2026-03-28-00z. I queried raw-store and there are ~900 spans with event_ts inside the window but ingested +40-120m.

marco: infra noticed high producer-side CPU around 23:45 UTC that correlates with Kinesis shard retries. That causes ingestion jitter.

jen: immediate mitigation: increase finalization grace window from 20m to 90m for hourly windows and enable a feature-flag so we can revert quickly. Owner: jen. ETA: 3h.

marco: I'll look into producer-side throttling and scale targets; might need autoscaler cooldown to avoid thrash. Owner: marco. ETA: EOD.

aditya: we should also add a proactive detector: compare aggregator counts with raw-store hourly and emit a missing-span alert when delta > 0.5%. Owner: aditya. ETA: EOD.

rachel: propose two longer term fixes: (A) a reconciliation/backfill job that can re-run finished windows against raw-store for last 72h, and (B) add watermarking so aggregator waits for an ingestion-watermark rather than pure inactivity. Owners: aditya + rachel. ETA: design spike 1 week.

ops-bot: Created ticket INFR-4627: "Window finalization race causing missing spans". Assigned to @jen, @marco, @aditya.

jen: rolling config change to staging now; will run canary on 5% of traffic in staging cluster and run synthetic late spans test.

marco: infra note: autoscaler logs show scale-down at 23:46 then immediate scale-up at 23:48; that window aligns with Kinesis rebalances. I will patch the scale policy with 5m cooldown.

aditya: detector dashboard added and alert rule: aggregator.raw_vs_agg.delta_pct > 0.5% for 15m -> page oncall.

jen: staging test: forced late ingestion, with grace=90m aggregator included late spans on re-run. No throughput regressions.

jen: canary started in prod at 02:05 UTC on 10% traffic. Monitoring gap metrics and commit errors.

aditya: alert fired once during canary (0.8% delta over 15m) before canary patch applied; after patch delta dropped below threshold.

marco: scale cooldown patched and deployed. Will monitor shard retry counts overnight.

rachel: action summary: - jen: feature-flagged finalize-grace roll (3h) -> done in canary - aditya: raw_vs_agg detector + alert (EOD) -> done - marco: autoscaler cooldown & producer scale target adjustments (EOD) - rachel/aditya: reconciliation design spike (1 week) -> start Monday

rachel: QA plan for hotfix: 1) synth late spans 2) run aggregator finalize & reconciliation check 3) assert delta <0.2% for 24h window 4) watch detector alerts.

ops-bot: Added weekly follow-ups on INFR-4627 for 4 weeks.

jen: canary progressed to 50% after 30m, then 100% after 30m. No rollback necessary.

aditya: starting design doc for reconciliation job. Will include idempotency and rate limits for backfill. Link when ready.

marco: overnight telemetry shows shard retry counts down 70% after cooldown. Producer CPU smoothing observed.

rachel: will write a short postmortem summary for INFR-4627 and link the detector dashboard and runbook steps. ETA: tomorrow morning.

jen: closing active remediation updates here. Please add any regression notes to INFR-4627. :white_check_mark:
